note: Two tiers. error = regenerate the plan. warning = keep, log only. Aesthetic choices are warnings, not bans — a branded gradient is not slop.

rules.description: No emoji in headings or UI elements
No lorem ipsum or generic filler; use real workspace content
No 'Transform Your Business', 'Unlock Your Potential', 'The Future of X'
No fabricated reviews or invented customer quotes
Prefer solid brand colors over gradient hero backgrounds
Large radii (>16px) read as generic AI cards; use brand-appropriate values
Heavy drop shadows read as slop; prefer subtle depth
Use asymmetric layouts with visual tension where appropriate
Body text line-height should be at least 1.6
